kingdomsIntro: One kingdom in each corner of the map. Your kingdom is wherever you settle, and you can move to another one later.

features.title: Build a character
features.body: Pick from eight races (four are free), six classes and eight playstyles. All three stack, and each free race has an Awakened form at level 100.

features.title: Earn money by playing
features.body: Twelve jobs, from Miner and Fisher to Alchemist and Guard. You join each one at its own NPC in Aldoria, the spawn world, and get paid as you play.

features.title: Run the dungeons
features.body: The Sanctum of Skulls and the Whispering Maze. You fight through stages of mobs to a boss, and the rewards get bigger the deeper you go.

features.title: Dying isn't the end
features.body: The world is set to Hard, but every death leaves a grave with your items where you fell. Get back within 7 days, because other players can break it and after 7 days it's gone.

features.title: Get fresh resources every week
features.body: The resource world resets every Saturday night at 11 PM Eastern with a new seed, so there is always untouched land to mine and the newest blocks to find.

features.title: Play on anything
features.body: Java players join by address. Console, mobile and Windows Bedrock players join through a friend account, with no address to type.

staffIntro: The people behind the server. You'll find us in game and in the Discord.
staffImageAlt: Five players standing together on a wooden bridge at night, lit by lanterns
staffImageCaption: A few of us in game
about: BrindleWood started as a family realm. We grew way too big for the 10 people a realm allows, so we became a server.
From there we slowly started roleplaying, which is when we decided on Kingdoms and built the spawn we have now.
We wanted somewhere we could have fun, use a ton of different things, and welcome people who were strangers into the fold as family.

newHere.text: New here? Read Your First Hour for a step by step start.

leaderCta.title: Lead a Kingdom
leaderCta.body: Rosewood in the northeast and Subterra in the southeast have no leader yet. Open a ticket in our Discord with a name, a theme and how you plan to rule. You can rename the kingdom to fit your theme.

highlights.title: Build your character

highlights.title: Earn as you play
highlights.body: 12 jobs, plus free hourly, daily and weekly rewards.

highlights.title: Run the dungeons

highlights.body: Claim your land, build a home and share a guild bank.

freeLine: Free to play. No whitelist and no application. Just join.

happening.title: Most Active Player
happening.body: Each week's top player wins 50 coins and a cosmetic crate key, given the next time they join after the week ends.

hero.headline: Four kingdoms. One world. Your story.
hero.sub: Pick a race, earn a living, and settle a kingdom. Free to play, with no whitelist and no application.

join.heading: Join in three steps
java: Open Minecraft Java and go to **Multiplayer**, then **Add Server**.
Join and accept the resource pack.
bedrock: Search for and add **{bedrockFriend}** as a friend.
Join through their game and accept the resource pack.
join.javaNote: The first resource pack download can take up to about 5 minutes. It only happens once, so don't cancel it.
join.bedrockNote: Bedrock joins through a friend account, so there is no address to type. The first resource pack download can take about 3 minutes, once.
join.helpText: Stuck? Ask in our Discord and someone will help.

worldIntro: BrindleWood is a survival world with an RPG on top. Here is what that means in practice.

world.title: Make a character that's yours
world.body: Pick from eight races (four are free), six classes and eight playstyles. They all stack, and each free race has an Awakened form at level 100. Your race is permanent, so choose with care.

world.title: Get paid for playing
world.body: Twelve jobs, from Miner and Fisher to Alchemist and Guard. You join each one at its own NPC at spawn. There are free hourly, daily and weekly rewards too, and a key drop every night at 10:30 PM Eastern.

world.title: Fight through the dungeons
world.body: The Sanctum of Skulls is the easier of the two, and the Whispering Maze is a step up. You fight through stages of mobs to a boss, and the rewards get bigger the deeper you go.
world.imageAlt: A stone cavern with a red-carpeted bridge and mobs fighting inside the Sanctum of Skulls

world.title: Settle a kingdom
world.body: There is one kingdom in each corner of the map. Claim land, build a home and share a guild bank. Two kingdoms still need a leader, and you could be it.
world.imageAlt: A village of sandstone and terracotta buildings in Solyra

goodToKnow.title: Dying isn't the end
goodToKnow.body: Every death leaves a grave with your items where you fell. Get back within 7 days, because other players can break it and after 7 days it's gone.

goodToKnow.title: Fresh resources every week
goodToKnow.body: The resource world resets every Saturday at 11 PM Eastern with a new seed, so there is always untouched land to mine.

goodToKnow.title: Play on anything
goodToKnow.body: Java players join by address. Console, mobile and Windows Bedrock players join through a friend account.

finalCta.heading: Ready to join?
finalCta.body: It takes a few minutes the first time, and then you're in.

kingdomFacts.title: Your kingdom is where you live
kingdomFacts.body: There is no sign-up list. The kingdom you belong to is the area you settle in. When you join, the random teleport drops you in a random Kingdom, and you can ask in a Kingdom's forum on Discord for someone to show you around.

kingdomFacts.title: Leaders set the laws
kingdomFacts.body: Each leader decides how their kingdom runs, as long as it stays in line with the server rules.

kingdomFacts.title: Shared perks
kingdomFacts.body: Kingdoms share a guild bank and a shared ender chest.

kingdomFacts.title: You can move
kingdomFacts.body: Switching kingdoms is allowed. Only your inventory and ender chest contents come with you, your builds stay where they are, and your land must be unclaimed in the kingdom you're leaving.
